description: This file contains implementations of Orleans grain classes for testing reminders, including ReminderTestGrain2 and a copy ReminderTestCopyGrain, along with related helper classes and mock grains. It manages reminder registration, activation, deactivation, reminder handling, and persistence via files, and includes testing logic for reminder behaviors within Orleans grains.

classes.name: ReminderTestGrain2
classes.description: Test implementation of an Orleans grain that manages reminders, including starting, stopping, and handling reminder callbacks, with persistent reminder state stored in files.

classes.name: ReminderTestCopyGrain
classes.description: A copy of the ReminderTestGrain for testing, with similar functionality but simplified storage and logging mechanisms, tailored for a different test scenario.

classes.name: WrongReminderGrain
classes.description: A mock grain that attempts to start a reminder but is designed to fail or illustrate incorrect behavior.

classes.name: UnvalidatedReminderRegistry
classes.description: Helper class implementing IReminderRegistry to interact with Orleans remonder services without validation.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain activation, initializing state and loading missing reminders.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain deactivation, logs deactivation event.

methods.name: StartReminder
methods.description: Starts a new reminder with optional validation and schedules it, with cleanup of old data.

methods.name: ReceiveReminder
methods.description: Callback invoked when a reminder triggers; manages sequence number calculation, logging, and persistence.

methods.name: StopReminder
methods.description: Stops a reminder, updating internal state and unregistering from Orleans.

methods.name: GetMissingReminders
methods.description: Retrieves reminders that are registered in Orleans but missing in local cache.

methods.name: GetReminderPeriod
methods.description: Returns the period of a specific reminder.

methods.name: GetReminderDueTimeAndPeriod
methods.description: Returns the due time and period of a specific reminder.

methods.name: GetCounter
methods.description: Reads the current counter value for a reminder from a file.

methods.name: GetReminderObject
methods.description: Fetches the Orleans reminder object for a given reminder name.

methods.name: GetRemindersList
methods.description: Returns the list of all registered reminders.

methods.name: EraseReminderTable
methods.description: Clears the reminder table in Orleans for testing.
